shots.purpose: Introduce Fuzzby for the first time -- zooming in and out erratically while clipping flowers and singing his own chaos-chant, until a botched somersault spirals into a genuinely spectacular tumbling pass he never intended, and he claims full, undeserved credit for it.
shots.performanceAssignment: Fuzzby's flight is one big outward loop around the meadow: on the way out he flies cleanly and confidently THROUGH the flower corridor, threading between stems and blossoms without touching them, singing his own chant clearly and fully audibly the whole time -- no fixed heading, but no contact yet. Only on the way back, as his loop curves him toward Zenny's own flower again, does he clip a single flower -- one real physical contact, his body catching the stem, pollen bursting, petals flying. That one clip throws him into a genuinely messy, unplanned scramble -- flailing wings, wild near-misses, his body actually fighting and failing to recover, nothing performed or choreographed about it -- until one much bigger, more violent bounce than any before it launches him into the air and his tumbling body, entirely out of his own control, executes the double backflip and triple twist -- the gymnastic landing. He crash-lands hard, right back at the exact spot he started from, upright by pure luck -- a real, forceful impact, not a gentle touchdown: stems snap, a genuinely large pollen cloud bursts outward, his body compresses hard on contact before rebounding. His own landing surprises him as much as it would surprise anyone watching. The beat between confusion and pride is the whole joke: he genuinely doesn't know what just happened, and then decides he meant it all along. Throughout, Zenny hovers steadily in place at her own flower, actively gathering pollen from it with her front legs, never idle.
shots.camera: The camera launches with Fuzzby as he peels away from Zenny's flower into one continuous, wide swooping loop around the whole meadow. On the way out he flies clean and confident through the flower corridor, threading stems and blossoms without contact, his chant fully audible; the camera stays with him, losing and re-finding him through foliage and pollen haze as he travels, and does not cut back to Zenny until his own momentum carries him back around to exactly where he started. In the final two to three seconds, once Fuzzby has landed and settled into his triumphant pose, the camera performs one continuous, deliberate dolly-in move off Fuzzby and onto Zenny -- who has been hovering steadily at her flower the entire shot, actively gathering pollen from it -- pushing in close on her face as she reacts, holding there for a genuine, unhurried beat. This is a reframe within the same unbroken shot, never a cut.
shots.openingPose: Bee-height flower corridor. Fuzzby already zig-zagging unpredictably between towering stems, no fixed heading. Zenny is deeper in frame, hovering steadily in place at her own flower, actively working it -- her front legs busy gathering pollen from it -- entirely unbothered by him.
shots.cutInMotivation: Cutting out here is stronger than holding on Fuzzby's pose because the next beat needs a hard reset into his very next overreach -- lingering would over-reward a joke that already landed.
internalCuts: Fuzzby peels off Zenny's flower into a tight show-off circuit AROUND her own flower patch — never leaving it, orbiting her close, zig-zagging playfully between the nearest stems without touching a single one, singing his own chant clearly and fully audibly the whole time, fully committed to the performance, every syllable landing. Zenny stays at the centre of his circuit at her own flower, hovering steadily and actively gathering pollen with her front legs, calm and absorbed, visible throughout as he loops around her.

Mid-orbit, still circling her patch, he clips exactly one flower — a single, real, messy contact, not a stunt. It throws him completely off balance: an ugly, unplanned, out-of-control scramble of flailing wings and wild near-misses inside the same small patch, nothing graceful or choreographed about it, his body genuinely fighting to recover and failing — the chaos never leaves the circle around Zenny.

He's flung upward into a genuinely accidental, out-of-control double backflip with three full twists — messy, fast, nothing posed about it — and crash-lands hard right beside Zenny at her own flower, upright by pure luck: a real, forceful impact that snaps stems and sends a huge pollen cloud exploding outward around him. One quick blink — then he STRIKES the superhero pose: chest puffed out, chin high, one arm planted on his hip, the other fist raised, and a huge, unmistakably confident grin — utterly delighted with himself, not a flicker of doubt on his face. Zenny, still right there hovering at her flower and still gathering pollen, barely looks up.
shots.dialogueBinding: Fuzzby's vocal beat performs per the approved voice design.
shots.visualPayoff: The camera has pushed in close on Zenny's face as she hovers at her own flower, still actively gathering pollen from it: she gives one small, dry, deadpan head-shake, mouth closed, completely unimpressed, before turning back to her pollen work. Fuzzby remains just behind her in frame, still frozen in his undeserved triumphant superhero pose, pollen still settling from the bigger crash.

shots.purpose: One continuous beat: Fuzzby's showy flight crashes him into a golden-pollen moustache he treats as an achievement, and Zenny's deadpan verdict lands before her private smile escapes.
shots.performanceAssignment: Fuzzby performs the whole flight like a one-bee parade: face lit up in a huge open-mouthed grin, eyebrows high, chest puffed, one showman wave toward Zenny as he launches, glancing back to check she is watching. The grin holds one beat too long as control goes; only at the last instant does delight flip to wide-eyed alarm before his face -- only his face -- plants into the flower's pollen-heavy yellow centre. The flower compresses, bends and rebounds; a single golden pollen burst transfers onto his upper lip -- a loose golden handlebar moustache, all one powdery gold material, nothing dark anywhere on his face. Zenny hovers beside him in frame, watching flat, as he doesn't know it's there -- then his hand brushes it, and instead of alarm, delight blooms. He strokes the moustache between two fingers like a distinguished gentleman, chin lifting, eyebrows waggling; a loose clump plops off unnoticed. Still preening, chest out, he turns to Zenny for his vocal beat -- never going still, beaming right through her flat reply. Zenny stays near-motionless and flat through both lines, mouth closed while listening; only after her own line is completely finished does she turn half away, and the first tiny private cheek-lift escapes.
